description: Native menu bar / system tray app that monitors Codex, Grok, and Claude Code subscription quota
notes: Quosparr is a portable single-file build: the tar.gz archives contain only Quosparr.exe (self-contained, ships the SQLite runtime for its architecture; no extract_dir needed).

The app stores all of its data and configuration in %USERPROFILE%\.quosparr (accounts auth.json, preferences, widget snapshot). That location is outside Scoop's $dir, so it cannot be persisted; the .quosparr persist entry only pre-creates the in-app directory.

QUOSPARR_TEST_HOME and QUOSPARR_PREFS_DOMAIN are developer/test-only isolation hooks and are deliberately not set: redirecting the app home would break reads of ~/.codex, ~/.grok and ~/.claude credentials.
NSIS per-user installers Quosparr.Setup.<version>.<arch>.exe (silent flag /S, installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Quosparr) are also published if an installer is preferred.
Autoupdate hashes come from the release SHA256SUMS file.
